shared.role: Generated TypeScript types and schemas (not a workspace package, consumed via path aliases)

ui.role: Foundational React UI component library with Radix UI and styling utilities

web-core.role: Shared React application library with features, hooks, and business logic for web apps

local-web.role: Tauri desktop application entry point for local development

remote-web.role: Web-based application entry point for remote deployment

answer.direction: Dependencies flow upward: shared/ and ui form the base layer, web-core builds on them to provide reusable app logic, and local-web/remote-web both consume web-core with ui and shared/ at the top.

grade.judge_notes: Missing explicit mention of the '@/*' path alias for consuming web-core sources in app shells; lists shared as a direct dependency of local-web and remote-web when it should only be indirect through web-core.

spot_check.note: judge items 6/7 inconsistent (same bottom-up wording scored both ways; real direct shared imports called invented); author re-scored every item from the answer
